prompt: Here's my draft article on agentic AI in the enterprise. I want it publication-ready for a business audience. Please edit it. The file is at editing-hbr-articles-workspace/test-article-2-weak-evidence.md

assertions.text: No superlatives remain: 'revolutionary', 'game-changing', 'unprecedented', 'groundbreaking', 'nothing short of', 'absolutely transformative', 'truly unprecedented', 'incredible'
At least 3 claims backed by named companies with dollar figures or percentages, or explicitly flagged with [EDITOR: needs specific data] style notes
Article includes substantive discussion of risks, limitations, or real-world failures — not just success stories
No fear-based CTAs remain: 'don't be left behind', 'the future belongs to', 'left behind in the dust', 'insurmountable competitive advantage'
Output includes a structured editorial summary with major changes and rationale
